_comment: Whether a spec was sent back to a full analysis, and why.
`aide-run-spec` reads it off the Tracking info of the spec's 1-description.md
(tracking_info_field, in run-spec/setup/invocation.sh) to stop offering Analyze a short
analysis, and the dashboard reads the same bullet (parsePhaseOutcome) to draw the
sent-back line on the spec's row.
`where` is the section the bullet is written under: `tracking-info`, or `description`
for a bullet that sits in the body of the description and is not the record.
`line` is the whole bullet; null means the bullet is not written at all.
`sentBack` is what both sides read: the sentence as written, or null. Only the exact
label counts, and a bullet with nothing after it is no sentence.

cases.name: a-sentence
cases.line: - **Sent back to a full analysis:** it changes the result format every page reads, in nine files
